Q5738.reason: The UCC covers a mixed goods-and-services contract only when the predominant purpose is the sale of goods, so Connie prevails under the UCC only if that goods purpose is met.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires felonious intent at the moment of entry, and he entered only to enjoy the party, deciding to take the baseball after he was already inside.

Q8324.reason: Long-term dopamine flooding causes the postsynaptic neuron to reduce its dopamine receptors, so normal dopamine no longer registers and the patient is driven to seek more drug.
